quote.text: Today I learned that Sam Alito, a sitting Supreme Court justice, has gotten personally involved in the fight to save a Christopher Columbus statue in his hometown, providing a statement to the city council about the "insult to the Italian American community" www.nytimes.com/2026/10/11/o...

images.alt:
Gilda Rorro, a longtime leader in the New Jersey Italian community, began lobbying to reinstate the statue in Chambersburg after discussing the matter with an upset Justice Alito in 2020. She said she read aloud a statement written by the justice to the Trenton City Council arguing that the statue does not symbolize Columbus's deeds but rather the immigrants themselves.
"Poor Italian peasants made a long and difficult journey leaving everything they knew behind. And while many people in this country did not accept them, they wanted to claim that they had a rightful place here," Dr. Rorro said, quoting Justice Alito's message to the City Council in 2020. "That is what the statue symbolizes, and removing it is an insult to the Italian American community, tantamount to saying that their experience, all that they endured and contributed, accounts for nothing."
